input.quote: 5. Fees and Payment. The Parties agree to share any revenue generated as a result of this Agreement, or Customer's use of the Services or the Auction Platform, as set forth and detailed in each applicable Exhibit.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no audit, inspection or verification clause: searches for "audit", "inspect", "records", "verif" and "books" return no hits, and the only access obligation on us (p0001) is a cooperation covenant to enable service delivery. Because this is a revenue-share arrangement in which Kubient contracts with Advertisers and remits to us (p0023), silence leaves scope for Kubient to assert an implied verification right with no frequency, notice, cost or system-access limits, which is the playbook walk-away outcome. We therefore add an express audit limitation in section 5 matching the preferred position: once per twelve months, thirty days' written notice, normal business hours, an independent auditor bound by confidentiality no less protective than paragraph 12, off-site review only with no direct or remote access to our systems, and Kubient's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%. Fifteen days' notice and a 10% threshold are acceptable fallbacks; system access is not.

proposal.summary: Add express limits on any Kubient audit or verification of Customer: once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, off-site only with no system access, at Kubient's cost absent underpayment over 5%.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on audit rights, so we have added an express limit confirming that any audit or verification of our records or usage is off-site, once per twelve months, on thirty days' notice, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality and at Kubient's cost unless an underpayment exceeds 5%. We can accept fifteen days' notice and a 10% underpayment threshold as a fallback, but we cannot give Kubient access to our systems.

ops.text: Audit Limitation. Any audit, inspection or verification by Kubient of Customer's records, payments or use of the Services shall be conducted no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice, during Customer's normal business hours, and by an independent third-party auditor bound by written confidentiality obligations no less protective than those set forth in paragraph 12. Any such audit shall be conducted off-site by review of records Customer makes available, and in no event shall Kubient or its auditor have direct or remote access to Customer's systems, networks, facilities or Content. Kubient shall bear all costs of any such audit unless the audit establishes an underpayment by Customer exceeding five percent (5%) of the amounts properly due for the audited period.
